sources.title: Grampians Peaks Trail
sources.excerpt: The Grampians Peaks Trail is a 164 km (102 mi) long walking track in the Grampians National Park, Victoria, Australia. The trail traverses the park from north to south and is split into 3 main sections known as the Northern Section, Central Section and Southern Section. The area traverses a wide range of different terrains including rugged rocky mountains, valleys, ridge-lines alongside abundant flora and fauna.
